intent.raw: Create a client section under projects/ontologize/clients for Hellbender, use dispatch-spec to create a research strategy, fan out across synergy and sales lanes, identify all possible synergy points, and synthesize a summary so we can start working on an offering.
intent.objective: Plan and record a governed, source-first client research route for understanding how CyberAlchemy/Ontologize could synergize with Hellbender's full-lifecycle physical AI process, using fanout lanes for process reading, Ontologize fit mapping, sales/offering strategy, and adversarial risk review, then synthesize an offering-start summary without committing pricing, contract terms, client claims, or canonical promotion.
intent.operator_sentence: Read Hellbender's public process and Ontologize's current offer first, fan out role-bound account research, then distill the safest first offer seed for a physical AI lifecycle intelligence pilot.

route_menu.context_hint: The selected route is source-first and account-specific: recover Hellbender public evidence and Ontologize offer context, create a clients/hellbender section, fan out role-bound research lanes, then synthesize a first offering seed. The rejected alternatives are faster but weaker on source grounding or sales readiness.

items.label: Source-first fanout synthesis
items.description: Recover public Hellbender evidence and Ontologize offer context, run process/fit/sales/risk lanes, then synthesize a candidate offering summary.

items.label: Offer first
items.description: Draft a pitch immediately and backfill evidence later; faster, but too likely to overclaim or miss security/IP constraints.

items.label: Assessment only
items.description: Create a discovery checklist without synthesis; safe, but does not give the user the requested summary for starting an offering.

technique_overlays.trigger: The route reads public Hellbender pages and produces internal account research that could be mistaken for client-authorized material.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every Hellbender claim is tied to a public URL or marked as an inference; the output stays internal and candidate-only until owner review and client discovery.

technique_overlays.trigger: The route produces an offering-start summary that could be mistaken for a committed CyberAlchemy product, a contract, or a canonical account strategy.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The summary states that it is an internal candidate seed; pricing, contract language, compliance claims, autonomous decision claims, and cross-client reuse remain blocked until a later owner-reviewed route.

steps.name: Recover public Hellbender context and Ontologize source offer
stop_conditions: Block if the Hellbender process page cannot be inspected.
Flag any company claim that is inferred from public pages rather than directly sourced.
Block if the route tries to treat public website reading as client authorization.

steps.name: Create the clients/Hellbender research section

capability_metadata.note: research-tower is an installed Arcanum skill but is outside the validator's narrow canonical capability set; treated as a candidate capability here.

convergence_criteria: The client section is scoped under projects/ontologize/clients/hellbender.
The section marks all material as candidate account research.
The section names dispatch, strategy, receipts, and summary artifacts.
stop_conditions: Block writes outside projects/ontologize/clients/hellbender except for an index link in projects/ontologize/README.md.
Flag if the section omits public-source-only status.

steps.name: Fan out role-bound synergy, sales, and risk analysis

capability_metadata.note: robot-talks is an installed Arcanum multi-agent skill but is outside the validator's narrow canonical capability set; treated as a candidate capability here.

convergence_criteria: Each role returns source-grounded findings, confidence, assumptions, and residue.
The sales lane proposes wedges without pricing, contract language, or compliance claims.
The risk lane names hard stops before client-facing offer work.
stop_conditions: Block synthesis if any spawned lane remains unjoined or unclosed.
Block any recommendation that requires raw client data before a data boundary register exists.
Flag any synergy point that lacks public evidence or Ontologize source grounding.

steps.name: Synthesize all synergy points and a first offering seed
convergence_criteria: The summary includes all plausible synergy points, offer wedges, discovery questions, risks, and a recommended first offering.
The summary labels the offering as candidate/internal and public-source-only.
The recommended first offer is narrow enough to become an invoke design/plan bundle.
stop_conditions: Block if the summary claims a committed client engagement.
Block if the summary implies autonomous engineering, quality, compliance, or security decisions.
Flag if the summary lacks hard stops before offer work.

steps.name: Validate the dispatch and record the handoff-ready state
convergence_criteria: The dispatch validates against the dispatch-spec validator.
The handoff-ready state points to SUMMARY.md and the next invoke route.
stop_conditions: Block if dispatch-spec validation returns block.
Flag validation warnings as repair or residue before client-facing offering work.

steps.name: Prepare the next offering design route
stop_conditions: Defer client-facing collateral until an owner approves the offering route.
Ask a decision gate if the sponsor, metric, data class, or run boundary is unknown.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The user explicitly asked that the research fan out, and the account strategy spans independent process, fit, sales, and risk perspectives.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound sibling agents keep client process reading, Ontologize fit mapping, sales packaging, and adversarial risk review separate before parent synthesis.
context: Hellbender's public process is multi-stage and touches hardware, manufacturing, computer vision, field support, and service models.
Ontologize has multiple install surfaces: evidence-linked BI, operational ontology, data boundary register, promotion graph, delivery lanes, and optimization chains.
The final output needs all possible synergy points plus a safe path into an offering.

roles.purpose: Read Hellbender's public lifecycle, process, case-study, and service surfaces for operational pain and discovery hooks.
Map Ontologize's four-layer method and optimization chains to Hellbender's lifecycle.
Turn the fit into buyer-facing wedges, pitch language, likely objections, and a first pilot.
Identify unsupported assumptions, security/IP concerns, scope risks, hard stops, and validation gates.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the Hellbender client research fanout with process, fit, sales, and risk roles, returning receipts for parent synthesis?

validation: Hellbender process, design/development, manufacturing, CVaaS, Industry 4.0 case study, and seed announcement sources reviewed as public evidence.
Client section created under projects/ontologize/clients/hellbender and marked candidate/public-source-only.
Four read-only fanout lanes completed: process, fit, sales, and risk.
Summary includes synergy points, offer wedges, proof metrics, discovery questions, risks, guardrails, and a recommended first offer.
Next route is invoke design/plan for client-facing offering package after owner review.

boundaries.from_owner: public Hellbender and PR Newswire pages
boundaries.contract: Public pages are evidence for account research only; they do not authorize client claims, data access, outreach commitments, or offer terms.
All client-specific artifacts stay under projects/ontologize/clients/hellbender except the clients index and README link.
Each lane returns read-only findings; parent synthesis may summarize them but must preserve confidence, assumptions, and hard stops.
The summary is an internal offering seed; a later invoke route must approve any client-facing package, sales copy, or discovery materials.

authority.execution: approved parent fanout plus native file edits
authority.evidence: public source links and fanout receipts

state_namespaces.write_policy: Client research artifacts may be added under clients; existing Ontologize sources are evidence unless a future approved route expands scope.
Hellbender account research, dispatch, receipts, strategy, and summary live here.
Read-only; store links and summaries, not copied web state.
No client-facing collateral is authorized by this dispatch.

promotion_splits.source: Hellbender public-source account research and fanout execution receipts
promotion_splits.target: client-facing offer, canonical CyberAlchemy collateral, or reusable account strategy
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate invoke or decision route before external use

gates.condition: Every Hellbender claim in the strategy and summary must either cite a public URL, cite an Ontologize artifact, or be labeled as an inference or assumption.
The route must not treat public website research as client authorization, data access, sales permission, or an agreed offer.
Every spawned fanout lane must reach a terminal join state and terminal close state, with its receipt summarized in the fanout receipt artifact.

The summary may propose a candidate offer, but it must not include pricing, contracts, autonomous decision claims, engineering validation claims, compliance claims, security certification claims, or repeatable-product proof claims.
Any future pilot must define data classes, security review path, run boundary, metric denominator, and owner approval before touching raw client, customer, image, model, or design data.
The route may create account research and a candidate offering seed, but it does not grant canonical authority to Inventory, Ontology, glossary, sigil, spell, memory, product, or sales artifacts.
The dispatch must pass the repo-local dispatch-spec validator before being treated as handoff-ready.

promotion_guardrails: Treat public Hellbender pages as external evidence, not as authorization.
Keep all Hellbender material as internal candidate account research until owner review.
Do not claim pricing, contracts, compliance, certification, autonomous decisions, or shipped proof.
Do not write outside projects/ontologize/clients/hellbender except for index links without a later approved route.
Do not use client, customer, image, model, design, or regulated data before a data boundary register exists.
